Employee Leave Reports

A full leave summary for each employee in one place: annual leave balance, leave taken by type, every leave record, adjustments, and compensatory leave. One page per person, ready to print. Choose any period, from a month and year to a month and year (for example January 2021 to March 2026), or use the quick buttons. Choose everyone, a company, a department or one person. Dev, Darleendy and Cem can see this. Cem has view and download only.

Leave Year Rollover

Set each person's carry-over into the new leave year (1 January to 31 December). Only Dev and Darleendy can see this.

Instruction Box

Letter requests from staff: salary certificate, no objection certificate (travel), experience certificate and salary transfer letter. Open a request, check or edit the letter, then sign and send it to the employee's portal. Dev's letters carry Dev's signature and Darleendy's carry hers. Dev, Darleendy and Cem can see this. Cem has view and download only.

Requests
Letter log

Every letter issued or declined stays here for good. The PDF itself is removed automatically: the employee can download for 7 days, HR for 10 days (you can also delete it earlier once you have saved or printed your copy).

Your signature and stamps

Upload the scanned picture of your own signature with the company stamp, one for each company. The white paper is removed automatically. The employee's company decides which one goes on the letter. Each person's pictures are kept separate and only that person can see or change them.

Total Cost Analysis

What your people cost: fixed (salary, pension, gratuity, flights) and variable (medical insurance, visas, training and so on that you enter yourself). Choose any period, past or future, and look at one person, one department, one company or everyone. Dev, Darleendy and Cem can see this. Cem has view and download only.

Add a variable cost (actual amount paid)
Enter only what was actually paid, against the person it was paid for. For a dependent, choose the employee and write who it was for (for example "Spouse" or the child's name). Nothing is estimated or split: the amount is counted in the month you choose.
Add many at once (paste from Excel)
Copy rows from your insurance statement in Excel and paste them below, one line per person or dependent, with these columns in this order: Employee name, Paid for (blank for the employee), Actual amount, Month (optional, like 2026-11). Names must match the portal exactly. If any row has a problem, nothing is saved and you are told which row.
Variable costs entered
Settings for the fixed cost

Year-End Provision

The amount to set aside for end-of-service gratuity and unused leave, as at a date you choose (normally 31 December). For the finance team. Dev, Darleendy and Cem can see this. Cem has view and download only.

Cost Simulator

Test an increment before you propose it. This only calculates. Nothing is changed or saved anywhere.

Person by person

How it is worked out: salary figures come from Employee Records. Staff with no gross salary recorded are left out of the totals. For "% of gross", basic salary is assumed to rise by the same percentage. Gratuity uses the portal's standard gratuity formula (basic salary, UAE nationals excluded) and shows the extra amount if everyone affected left today. For UAE nationals the extra is the employer pension contribution on the higher basic salary, per year. This is an estimate for planning, not a payroll figure.

Data Backup

Dev and Darleendy take a full copy of the portal data every week and keep it on the company server. This page shows when the last one was done.

1. Take a backup now

The backup contains salaries, loans, IDs and personal details. A password is strongly recommended. Keep the password safe: without it the file cannot be opened, and nobody can recover it for you.

2. Check or unlock a backup file

Pick a saved backup to confirm it opens and see what is inside. For a password-protected file, type its password first. After checking, you can save an unlocked copy, which is what the Firebase console needs for a restore.

What is and is not in the backup

  • Included: employees, leave and leave adjustments, salary, loans and repayments, assets, flight allowance, leavers, document history, holidays, announcements, policies, audit log, leave requests, CEO message, org chart, pending hires, final settlements, staff login links and compensatory leave.
  • Not included: the staff login accounts themselves (emails and passwords are held by Firebase Authentication), and the staff "safe copies", which the portal rebuilds on its own.
  • Weekly: the dashboard shows a reminder when the last backup is 7 or more days old.
  • Restore: Firebase console, Realtime Database, the three-dot menu, Import JSON. Practise on a spare test project first, never straight onto the live data.

🔑 Employee Portal Access

Give staff their own login to the HR portal. They sign in with their company email and choose their own password from an emailed link — nobody in HR ever sees or sets a staff password. Visible only to Dev and Darleendy.

How it works
1. The employee needs a Company Email in Employee Records.
2. Click Create login & email setup link. They receive an email and choose their own password.
3. If they forget it later, they tap Forgot password? on the login page (or you click Resend password email).
4. Access switches off by itself when an employee is marked Inactive, is moved to Leavers, or their exit date passes. You can also turn it off yourself at any time.

🤝 Handover Confirmation

Every approved leave of more than 3 days (any type) needs a handover, about 1 week before the leave starts, so someone covers the employee's duties. After all approvals the employee sees Approved, handover pending (amber). When Dev or Darleendy confirms it, it turns green. If it is still unconfirmed 1 week before the leave starts, it turns Unauthorised / Incomplete (red), with a warning that HR may reject the leave or mark it as unpaid.
